name: bedrock-e2e
description: Host-side Playwright e2e tier. Runs against the live DDEV URL; the single entry point is bin/e2e.sh (composer test:e2e / ddev test-e2e / npm run test:e2e all converge on it). NOTE: this root package is NOT covered by the audit:js gate (bin/js-gate.sh loops theme dirs only).
